notes.title: 5000 Wishlists 🩸 | Slain 2: The Beast Within
notes.content:
We're only a few weeks into the announcement of [b]Slain 2: The Beast Within[/b], and we've already crossed 5,000 Wishlists on Steam!

A massive [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who's shown early support - it’s been amazing to see the response so far. Whether you’ve followed Slain 2 over here, shared gifs on social media, or just screamed 'BATHORYN'S BACK!' into the void… we see you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/394c29652b2983e27600ea3c6b23b32c19de2e2e.gif[/img]

This is just the beginning. Development is still in its early stages, but we’ve got a whole lot of blood, steel, and metal-packed action in store. The full moon is rising: we can’t wait to show you more as things come together.

If you want to catch the freshest glimpses of what we’re working on - GIFs, pixel art, behind-the-scenes teases - be sure to follow[b] [url=https://x.com/MrAwolf]Steel Mantis[/url][/b] on Twitter/X. You cannot miss the latest sneak-peaks from the artist himself. 

And again - thank you. There’s more metal where that came from.
Stay tuned. The hunt has just begun. Let's rock 🤘🤘🤘

notes.title: SLAIN IS BACK - Slain 2: The Beast Within
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/e1044c10c91657f83949e571a011f08ecab9888c.png[/img]
[b]Steel Mantis and Silver Lining Interactive [/b]are back to deliver a blood-soaked, pixel-art action platformer like never before!

After the massive success of [b]Slain: Back From Hell, Slain 2:The Beast within[/b] returns with the same ferocious, fast-paced combat and brutal challenge that fans loved, but this time, it’s set in an all-new, darker fantasy world. The moon is rising, the blood is flowing, and the hunt begins - are you ready to answer its call?

[h2]What's back and better than ever![/h2]

[h3]Ferocious Hack-and-Slash Combat[/h3] 
The signature, fast, satisfying melee combat returns, with even more brutal ways to cleave through enemies.

[h3]Bathoryn is BACK[/h3] 
Bathoryn returns as a sentient sword, now in your hands. The deadly blade is ready to unleash its elemental fury to tear through hordes of monstrous enemies. 

[h2]What new can you expect?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/a2570878192fee6ed92dbbca373f26e5f828fd60.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/083fff5d2bf7ead2a52145b34eaf804b1f7eea31.png[/img]
Prince Akran, the last of the cursed Wolf Knights is on a quest to save the world as he knows it. Transform into a savage werewolf under the full moon, and unleash unimaginable speed and power on your enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/cc8c55ceac1f18cd63076871f00374fa30d158c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/264a10545106378c2074d21cf1fe2e6f7fa808d2.png[/img]
Embark on three unique, perilous quests - each filled with challenging enemies, deep lore, and epic battles against impossible odds. Sacrifices must be made, and your strength will be tested like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/a8d1ee4d3bbf6c22b14dd8db55a0d999bfa2e56f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585337/34c383932646329ccb1e88f6294a17747e00a5c1.png[/img]
From the very first moments of the game, you’ll feel the grim weight of the world around you. Your path will be treacherous, but the thrill of combat and the lure of Bathoryn’s power will keep you pushing forward.

[h2]What are you waiting for? Wishlist now![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601680/Slain_2_The_Beast_Within/
